name: Miser’s Magic
body:
You can squeeze just a bit of magic out of your own luck.

Prerequisite(s): Grit, panache, mettle, or inspiration pool; Spellcraft 3 ranks, no class feature which grants spells or extracts.

Benefit(s): Choose 2 1st-level spells from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. You may cast these spells by spending one point from the pool you used to qualify from this feat. Use your character level as the caster level for these spells and the ability modifier used to determine your grit, panache, mettle, or inspiration pool (whichever is highest if you have multiple pools) is used to determine the save DC of these spells if applicable.
